description.value:
The joints lock comfortably, and they like it there.

Gift — Hold a crouch, kneel or brace indefinitely without fatigue; +1 circumstance to Athletics to hold position against forced movement while braced. Tithe — Getting up is slow. The first time each encounter you stand from prone or release a brace, it costs an extra action.

cinderfall.incomplete: "The first time each encounter you stand from prone or release a brace, it costs an extra action" has no rule-element equivalent: no hook exists for changing the action cost of an existing baseline action (Standing) the first time it's used each encounter -- pf2e's per-encounter-use tracking is built for granted actions with their own frequency field, not for modifying a universal action everyone already has.
